technical.summary: Extreme overbought conditions across multiple RSI periods with price below 200MA create high exhaustion risk; confluence is strong but momentum divergences and low volume suggest poor risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: LUV shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 78 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for LUV; congressional activity is mixed and immaterial, broad market sentiment is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (291.36), imminent CPI event, and recession risk severely outweigh the 78-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 14 extreme overbought + supertrend bullish + Ichimoku above cloud create strong technical confluence with price near support (34.37), offering a defined risk entry for mean reversion traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro stress (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve, recession risk), zero fundamental conviction (no insider/institutional buying), momentum divergences (RSI 9 not rising, price below 200MA), and low volume (0.54 ratio) create unacceptable risk/reward despite technical overbought setup.

decision.primary_risk: Macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, recession risk) will likely override technical bounce; earnings in 78 days add uncertainty; existing LUV position and 45 Industrials holdings create concentration drag.
